Our Policies

Terms & Conditions

Welcome to Printalarm – Shagun Couture. By using this website, you agree to the following Terms & Conditions.

1. Products

Printalarm offers personalized Shagun Lifafas and wedding money envelopes. Because every product is customized, slight variations in color, print, or finishing may occur.

2. Personalization

Customers are responsible for providing accurate:

  • Names
  • Family names
  • Blessings
  • Messages
  • Photos
  • Design preferences

Once production begins, personalization details cannot be changed.

3. Order Confirmation

Orders are confirmed only after communication through WhatsApp. Submitting information through the website does not guarantee order acceptance. We reserve the right to accept or decline any order.

4. Payments

Printalarm does not process payments on this website. No online payment gateway is available. Payment (if applicable) is discussed separately during WhatsApp order confirmation.

5. Pricing

Prices displayed on the website are subject to change without prior notice. Final pricing will be confirmed during order confirmation.

6. Production Time

Customized orders generally require 2–3 business days for production. Delivery timelines may vary depending on your location.

7. Shipping

Shipping times are estimates only. Printalarm is not responsible for courier delays caused by:

8. Cancellation

Because products are personalized, orders cannot be cancelled once production has started.

9. Refund & Replacement

Refunds or replacements are provided only for products damaged during transit, subject to our Return & Exchange Policy. Personalized products cannot be returned due to:
